shape:
Exhibit ONE opens with its purpose: the 'Stable forms each living file meets' paragraph moved to the top under the title, with one plain line: 'Resolver in code, and the tables it produces, for matching against what a science observes; each table is code executed and can be re-run.' Then the code with 'Code with each name' as its seventeen-line legend, the names table, the drawing, and one line counting code's branches.

Next, forms among names, each a table with a one-line plain lead and no explaining: Names (seventeen names; 'each number in four bits, its step and whether it is shared'); Four-cyclings ('the sixteen names as four rows of now, next, prior, same'); Roots, with co and without ('which names are shared between two and which belong to one'); Between selves ('the three pairs that cross from one self to another'); Four binaries ('each binary's odd is-name and even is-not-name'); Moves ('each name 8 up, 9 less and 17 less'); Twelve forms, in numbers ('cycles the moves make, with their partners'); Odd and even, 8 apart ('names paired with their next'); Zeros ('where a 0 arises, passes, or cannot'); Fives ('each side's five dimensions as five numbers'); Momentaries of exchanging ('four exchanges in a self's span'); Scales ('each name one scale in and out, n to 8n-7'; then the eight inward 1 to 17s).

Then resolving tables, one lead each: Offerings surfacing ('what 14 surfaces for each mix of offerings'); One momentary ('for each prior, + or - or none, and each surfacing: shared and next prior'), with + and - alike as its close. Then tables of selves, led by 'Each table is code executed with the stated opening; it shows that and nothing wider': one self over eight momentaries, with the checked counts 2,916 and 32,768 as one line; spiral (closed by two momentaries before, inverted); two spirals beside and crossed; torus (closed by its two carried forms); two selves; two selves, five parities; three selves; spiral opened with no prior. Explaining paragraphs, the seventeen per-name entries and the namings-of-names leave. Each per-name field is read from its table, and the five fields no table carries are placed first.

Natural Intelligence carries the reader in and out. Going in, 3.3 already says what the object is; add one paragraph on how to use it: take an observed pattern, find the table whose form it matches (period 4n, 4pq, q or 4p, a turn coming back changed or same), re-run the code with that opening, and see if the parity agrees. Part FOUR then becomes the single telling of everything that leaves (living is prior, parity as moral values, five dimensions, observing's one line, 0 as between, turn-taking, the corus wrapping, the same-existing-society) and points back to tables by plain name instead of repeating their numbers. Coming out, a short close per form family says which other living file uses it: THREE Numbers and THIRTY Co-Chaining for spirals, tori and podals; TWO Networking for moves; TWENTY Naming for the namings; TWENTY-NINE Illustrating for the drawings.
